name: 金庸群侠传（2008 标准版）
english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2008 Standard Edition)
english_description: The base "2008" release of this project's 金庸群侠传/"Jin Yong Heroes Gathering" (ES II engine) family -- a full raw-archive diff against sibling jqxz2008 ("Enhanced") turned up only 22 differing files out of 3,772, none engine-relevant (shorter room text and fewer quest-list entries, consistent with the Enhanced edition's own branding). Same tea-house start, Beggars'-Sect passphrase-hideout join under 左全/Zuo Quan, and White Camel Mount recruiter path as its siblings.
